Logging.//EventLog: The service's ONLY output. Microsoft's EventLog provider caps itself at Warning no matter what LogLevel:Default says, because that rule is per-provider and the one above is not scoped to it. Left at the default, every line the agent writes about a sync -- 'Starting sync', the per-feed row counts, 'Sync complete' -- is dropped, and the Application log shows nothing but the Start/Stop entries ServiceBase.AutoLog writes directly, which are not ours and pass through no filter. A box that had silently sent no sales for a month was indistinguishable in its log from a healthy one, and took a sequence of hand-run commands on the POS to tell apart. Information here is what makes `Z:2 EW:16 Audit:51` readable after the fact, on the box, without a human standing at it.

Sync.//BusinessDayCutoffHour: Hour that starts a new trading day, 0-12. A bar open 17:00-03:00 trades across two calendar dates; sales before this hour are counted as part of the previous night. Set to 0 ONLY if the mapped date column already holds a true business date rather than a ticket timestamp — shifting an already-rounded date moves every night back a day. Setup detects which and sets this for you.
